_authored.description: Provenance of the human-approved write: who approved the profile and when

opportunity_ref_pattern.description: The tenant's folder-name pattern that identifies an opportunity/project folder; the anchor every other convention hangs off. Mandatory key; the value may be `null` when no candidate clears the bar

org_aliases.description: Alternative names for the org seen in the tree

org_display_name.description: The org's own display name, only when independently evidenced

stage_roots.description: The lifecycle-stage root folders under which numbered opportunity folders live; the tenant's document-geography spine. Mandatory key; an empty array is a valid value when no stage clears the coverage bar

submission_locations.description: Subpaths under a stage root where priced/schedule-named files cluster, ranked by occurrence — where a submission is expected. The subpath strings are tenant folder convention, never reproduced here

superseded_markers.description: Folder-name markers the tenant treats as stale-revision / do-not-use, after the LLM's semantic call. The marker vocabulary is tenant and contract defined, never reproduced here
